newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: PRESS DIGEST - Czech Republic - April 4.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Czech Republic - April 4.

text.p: MLADA FRONTA DNES - Investicni a postovni banka, the third largest bank in the Czech Republic denied speculation fommenting in the banking sector that it experienced serious losses in 1996.
- Harvardske podilove fondy have eliminated all obstacles preventing it from doing business. The Finance Ministry is currently reconsidering allowing the fund to commence business operations.

HOSPODARSKE NOVINY - The Czech economy is not in a state of crisis and the government is capable of dealing with problems without abandoning its market oriented policies says industry and trade minister Vladimir Dlouhy.

- Skoda Auto now ranks as the largest Czech industrial company with 1996 sales of 59 billion crowns, the company surpassed CEZ. According to auditing, Skoda Mlada Boleslav earned a profit of 163 million crowns last year.

- Lockheed announced that it is not prepared to make an equity investment into Aero Vodochody, the Czech Republic's largest arms producer, and maker of jet aircraft. Lockheed's CEO, Norman Augustine stated that the American industrial giant is inly interested in industrial cooperation with the Czech aircraft maker.
LIDOVE NOVINY - Pravel Tykac of Motoinvest stated that his company will sue Price Waterhouse if Motoinvest manages to obtain a copy of an audit of Agrobanka performed by the accounting firm .
PRAVO - Unless the current trend in declining tax revenues is reversed, the state budget deficit could grow to 64 billion crowns.
